{spk:0080}{n}You've seen it through to the end. Well done, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thanks to your work, Infos has regained the normal flow of time.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's all because you found the heroes and drew out their full strength.{n}{wait}{clear}Look, {name:0080}. The Stagnation of Time that covered Infos is clearing away.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{name:0080}... On behalf of those who live in Infos, let me thank you too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm grateful. You've truly worked hard.{n}{wait}{clear}As of today, you are relieved of your duty guarding Infos and will take up a post within Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}I know it's a pity, but you won't be able to see the heroes who worked for you anymore...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{spk:E783}{n}Gabriel-sama, about that...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What is it, {name:0080}?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{f7:0080}｛Actually, I have a request.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛No... it's nothing.　　　　｝{n}{end}

{spk:E783}{n}Actually, I have a request.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Would you send me back to Infos?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And what do you intend to do if you return to Infos?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}I want to live out my life as one of the people of Infos.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Gabriel-sama, please!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So... you choose that path after all.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}...Gabriel-sama?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Very well. I will allow you to live in Infos...{n}{wait}{clear}Living for someone else's sake is also a very precious thing...{n}{wait}{clear}But... before that, there is one thing I must command of you.{n}{wait}{clear}Leave your wings behind, {name:0080}. For humans have no wings...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}
{spk:E783}{n}No... it's nothing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}Then... {name:0080}. Before you leave Infos, go and say a word of farewell to the heroes.{n}{wait}{clear}The distorted past must be erased. The heroes will forget everything, including you...{n}{wait}{clear}Now, go and say your goodbyes.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}{name:0080}... I'm glad... You chose to become human.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You've truly done so much for me... I learned a great deal, too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Something in me certainly changed through this fight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}How should I put it... I feel I can see things from a broader view now.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}From now on, I want to make use of who I've become and do what I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And for that, I need your strength. {name:0080}... from now on, we'll always be together...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Is that so? {name:0080}... you're going back to Heaven...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}But that promise...! No, there's no point blaming you. It's already been decided, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I'm truly grateful to you. It was your strength that changed me this much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}A world without you means nothing to me... but I'll find a way to live in it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's a shame to part, but I'm sure you'll do fine back in Heaven, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I know you better than anyone, so I can't be wrong. Well then, take care...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Peace has finally returned... I never thought I could accomplish this much...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I think I learned many things through this fight. It's thanks to you, {name:0080}... I'm grateful.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}So, I hear you're becoming human, {name:0080}. That's just like you. Come see me anytime. You'll always be welcome.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see, so this is goodbye. It's a shame, but for an angel like you, {name:0080}, it's only natural, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I owe you my thanks. I never thought I'd win back peace with my own hands... and...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I feel I've gained something very precious. Thank you. I won't forget you. Always keep being you, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Really! ...You'll become human. You made that choice, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Walking this road with you, I learned what I lost and what I gained in battle... and what it all means.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm grateful... And I'm grateful, too, that we can be together from now on.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm glad... truly...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}From now on, I'll live to support you. {name:0080}... I'll cherish you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}{name:0080}, those words of yours... No... let's not.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}For you, an angel, is it the natural choice...? Then I'll say nothing more...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I suppose I should be grateful I got to be with you at all...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I chased the ideals of a knight, but through this fight I feel I learned something more precious.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I won't forget you, {name:0080}... Thank you... This is farewell. I pray you do well in Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}...Peace has finally returned. It's thanks to you, {name:0080}, that I gained this much strength. I'm grateful.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I want everything I learned in this fight to nourish me from here on...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Still, becoming human... I'm sure you'll be fine, {name:0080}. Let's pray we meet again somewhere.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The world is at peace. So this is the end... Natural as it is, it's a shame.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I got this far only because you were with me, {name:0080}. I'm grateful... thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I'll live on without forgetting what this fight gave me. That's how I can repay you. I'll never forget. I pray for your success.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}
